EPISODE 2: The Funeral Clause

[00:00] INT. STERLING CORP - LOBBY - DAY
[00:03] Maya, now an intern at Sterling Corp, carries a tray of coffees.
[00:07] DAVID: You're the new intern? Floor 40. Don't spill on the CEO.
[00:11] MAYA: I've never even seen the CEO.
[00:14] INT. CITY HOSPITAL - ROOM 4 - DAY
[00:16] Lily, 19, sits up in bed, her left arm in a cast.
[00:20] LILY: Who paid for my surgery, Maya?
[00:23] MAYA: My husband. It's complicated.
[00:26] INT. STERLING MANSION - BEDROOM - NIGHT
[00:28] Rose lies in bed, hooked to a heart monitor. Ethan holds her hand.
[00:33] ROSE: Promise me Victor never touches the company.
[00:37] ETHAN: I promise, Grandma.
[00:40] The heart monitor flatlines. The doctor covers Rose's face with the sheet.
[00:45] Ethan breaks down at her bedside.
[00:48] INT. STERLING CORP - EXECUTIVE FLOOR - NIGHT
[00:50] Victor learns that Maya is Ethan's wife.
[00:55] VICTOR: An intern. Perfect. She'll be my way in.
[01:00] Maya steps out of the elevator and sees Ethan in a tailored suit at the head of the boardroom table.
[01:05] MAYA: You're... the CEO?
[01:08] TO BE CONTINUED
